descriptions.job-1vnvq4x:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The AI Startups team is focused on one of Stripe’s most strategic growth areas: enabling the monetization and scaling of AI-native and AI-enabled businesses. We are in a unique position to partner with the most ambitious AI companies at the forefront of artificial intelligence. Our team collaborates across infrastructure, foundational models, agents, and applications to support these companies in their growth and global commercialization using Stripe’s comprehensive financial stack.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Own contract renewals and lead commercial negotiations to increase revenue and market share among existing customers.
  • Develop and implement sales cycle strategies to drive product adoption, new sales, and client retention at scale.
  • Address complex client needs by collaborating with product, sales, risk, and operations teams to enhance our offerings.
  • Build and refine the go-to-market playbook for AI monetization and usage-based billing (UBB), including segmentation, messaging, sales strategy, and pipeline generation.
  • Engage with AI founders and industry influencers to position Stripe as the preferred infrastructure for monetizing AI.
  • Represent Stripe in market-facing activities (e.g., hackathons, webinars, events) to elevate our presence in the AI and billing ecosystem.

Who you are

We’re looking for a well-rounded strategic seller who can build strong relationships with Stripe’s clients and manage high velocity deal cycles. If you’re hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing/sales role
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and build great relationships with technical customers
  • Ability to drive and close upsell opportunities for additional Stripe products in long-term, consultative engagements
  • Analytical ability to manage complex pricing and cost considerations
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth technology company
  • Experience with Excel and SQL, or a willingness to learn
descriptions.job-10b834h:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business.

As the Senior Staff Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure, you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. Your primary focus will be DevX, owning the technical direction of Robinhood's most critical build and developer infrastructure. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just how Robinhood builds software today, but what engineering velocity looks like for the entire industry!

This role is based in our New York City or Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the technical direction and roadmap for the Developer Infrastructure org — serving as the Uber Tech Lead across DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform, unifying four engineering teams under a shared technical vision
  • Lead and evolve Robinhood's Bazel-based monorepo build infrastructure — own the remote build execution cluster, drive language-agnostic build optimization across Python, Go, TypeScript, and more, and ensure fast, stable feedback loops for the entire engineering org
  • Scale CI/CD pipelines to support thousands of daily builds with speed, safety, and reliability — overseeing GitHub repository configurations, pre-merge checks, and test execution infrastructure across the company
  • Drive the vision for TestX — the test infrastructure and environments that power Robinhood's entire test experience, including integration test environments and personal development environments that simulate the full Robinhood system so engineers can test safely and confidently
  • Champion the integration of AI and agentic systems across the full software development lifecycle — driving initiatives that use intelligent automation and coding agents to multiply developer velocity, improve code quality, and accelerate the pace of innovation across the org
  • Set technical standards across Backend Platform and Mobile Platform — owning the vision for core language runtimes, libraries, IDE tooling, and developer environment security across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute a long-term developer infrastructure roadmap that embeds AI as a force multiplier at every layer of the SDLC

What you bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record at the Senior Staff, Principal, or Distinguished Engineer level — you've set technical direction at the org or company level, not just the team level
  • Deep expertise with Bazel and large-scale monorepo build systems — you've owned remote build execution infrastructure at scale and understand the architectural tradeoffs deeply
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines at massive scale — across thousands of daily builds, multiple programming languages, and complex pre-merge pipeline logic
  • Fluency in Go and/or Python; broad familiarity with TypeScript, Swift, or Android development environments is a strong signal
  • Strong background with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) — you understand the full stack of developer tooling from IDE to deployment
  • Experience with test infrastructure, integration test environments, or developer environment platforms — you understand what a great test experience looks like at scale
  • Genuine interest in or hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, automated code review, or AI-driven developer velocity programs — you have a clear point of view on how AI will reshape the software development lifecycle and want to be the one building it
  • Exceptional technical leadership, communication, and influence skills — you've unified cross-functional engineering teams around a shared vision and driven ambiguous, org-spanning initiatives to completion
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating the technical bar across large, diverse engineering organizations

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

descriptions.job-1i7qnkh:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere 

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  Work from anywhere!

Position overview

Xapo Bank is establishing a Structured Solutions function to own and expand its product offering, spanning yield products, tokenisation, asset-backed lending (ABL) workstreams, and new structures at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance.

As Head of Structured Solutions, you will take ownership of an established, revenue-generating credit fund and the counterparty relationships that sit behind it, while setting the strategic direction for what we build next. You will report directly to the CFO, own the house view on structured product strategy, act as the primary interface with our external licensed Investment Manager and the Investment Committee, and have the mandate and budget to grow the team as the function scales.

This is a rare combination: a live book with existing counterparties, an established governance process, and dedicated analyst support from day one, alongside genuine authority to shape what Xapo Bank's structured product offering becomes and to build the team you need to deliver it. You will have a structured transition period working alongside experienced outgoing team members to absorb institutional knowledge, models, data, and counterparty context.

Credit judgement is central to this role, not a supporting activity. Counterparty selection, due diligence and ongoing monitoring are how the credit fund is managed day to day, so we need someone whose underwriting is as strong as their structuring, as credible assessing a counterparty as they are designing a payoff profile, with the judgement to walk away from a deal that prices well but underwrites badly.

In your first 12 months you will:

  • Take full ownership of the fund and its counterparty relationships, completing the knowledge transfer from the outgoing team.
  • Establish your operating rhythm with the Investment Committee and the licensed Investment Manager.
  • Set out the forward roadmap for Xapo's structured product offering and the resourcing to deliver it.

Responsibilities

Strategy and product:

  • Set the strategic direction and house view for structured investment solutions, identifying and designing new structured products for the Xapo client base.
  • Lead delivery of yield products, tokenisation initiatives, Bitcoin Backed Loans, and other new structures from concept through to launch, from payoff profile through to delivery mechanism, including regulatory consequences.
  • Responsible for driving Xapo's internal investment committee, a monthly forum with the CEO, CFO, and Head of Product, on new ideas, products, and structures.

Credit, due diligence, and risk:

FUND

  • Own comprehensive initial due diligence on prospective counterparties and ongoing due diligence on existing ones, covering counterparty financial analysis, business processes, and risk evaluation.
  • Produce credit assessments in a standardised, committee-ready format suitable for review by the licensed Investment Manager and the Investment Committee.
  • Maintain ongoing credit risk oversight of the book, ensuring positions are managed appropriately and the fund operates within its mandate at all times.
  • Set, monitor, and enforce exposure, concentration, and limit frameworks, escalating breaches and emerging risks promptly.

XAPO

  • Work alongside the Risk function on price risk and credit risk evaluation, system requirements, and regulatory consequences.

Fund Origination, execution, and relationships:

  • Identify and originate new counterparties for the fund to lend to.
  • Prepare and present due diligence and lending proposals through the Investment Committee, owning the quality and rigour of the committee process.
  • Support Legal in negotiating the fund's standard documentation with counterparties through to close.
  • Maintain and evolve counterparty relationships across the life of each facility, keeping engagement current across all commercial and operational matters.

Fund operations and stakeholder management:

  • Act as the primary point of engagement with the external licensed Investment Manager on regulated fund management activity, maintaining constant contact.
  • Oversee fund operations and accounting, liaising with the fund administrator and fund accountant to ensure NAV is struck correctly and resolving operational issues as they arise.
  • Support Xapo Operations and the fund accountant on reconciliation, ensuring everything matches correctly.
  • Allocate coin and capital inflows arising from investors sourced by Xapo.
  • Represent the fund internally, keeping the wider Xapo organisation informed on positioning, activity, and performance.

Treasury and banking input:

  • Work closely with Treasury, providing advisory input across risk evaluation, trading and execution, and system requirements.
  • Contribute banking input on ALCO, stress testing, and pricing.

Team and knowledge:

  • Build, manage, and develop the Structured Solutions team, mentoring junior analysts and expanding the bench as the function grows — you will have the mandate to shape the team's size and shape over time.
  • Enable the team: surface and resolve blockers quickly, run regular one-to-ones, and take ownership of team wellbeing.
  • Represent the team within Xapo, articulating what it needs and keeping the organisation informed.
  • Ensure institutional knowledge is documented and durable, contributing to and maintaining the investment team knowledge portal so that the function is not dependent on any single individual.
  • Act as an internal reference point for technical, market, and crypto-ecosystem questions, contributing to projects across the business where relevant.
  • During the initial transition period, work alongside outgoing senior team members to absorb institutional knowledge, models, data, and counterparty context.

Skills needed

  • Substantial experience in investment management, structured products, or digital asset markets, including senior ownership of a product, credit, or trading function.
  • Demonstrable credit underwriting and counterparty risk experience, ideally including unsecured lending, with the judgement to say no to a deal that prices well but underwrites badly.
  • The ability to diligence both sides of the market: regulated financial institutions using audited financials, capital position, and covenant analysis; and crypto-native counterparties, including the limitations of proof-of-reserves, custody and rehypothecation risk, venue and exchange exposure, on-chain analysis, and opaque cross-jurisdictional group structures.
  • Strong quantitative capability and comfort building or overseeing pricing, risk, and structuring models.
  • A track record of designing and launching new financial products, ideally spanning yield, lending, or tokenisation.
  • Experience operating through formal governance processes such as investment committees, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
  • Demonstrated people leadership: building teams, developing junior talent, and setting a clear technical and strategic direction.
  • Familiarity with both Bitcoin and traditional fiat markets, and genuine interest in where digital assets and structured finance intersect.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with external investment managers, counterparties, and internal committees alike.

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to regulated fund structures and working alongside a licensed external investment manager.
  • Experience with fund operations, including fund administrators, fund accountants, and the NAV process.
  • Existing relationships within digital asset counterparty or institutional investor networks.
  • Prior experience standing up or scaling a new team or function within a fintech, bank, or asset manager.
  • Balance sheet and treasury experience, including ALCO, stress testing, and pricing within a regulated credit institution.
  • Experience taking over an existing book and making it your own, rather than only building from a blank page.

Other requirements:

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balance Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. 

  • Expect Excellence Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.
descriptions.job-0otxa1d:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
 
We are seeking an experienced MLRO / Principal Officer to lead the AML/CFT and financial crime compliance framework for a digital asset payments business operating in India.
The role will serve as the designated Principal Officer under applicable Indian AML requirements, with responsibility for regulatory reporting, AML governance and engagement with FIU-IND.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the designated Principal Officer / MLRO, overseeing compliance with the PMLA, PML Rules and applicable FIU-IND requirements.
  • Own and maintain the AML/CFT/CPF framework, including policies, risk assessments, transaction monitoring and supporting controls.
  • Oversee regulatory reporting to FIU-IND, including STR, CTR and other applicable filings.
  • Oversee KYC/KYB, CDD/EDD, sanctions screening and customer risk frameworks.
  • Oversee financial crime controls relating to fiat and virtual digital asset flows, including blockchain analytics and Travel Rule requirements.
  • Serve as the primary AML/CFT contact for FIU-IND and relevant authorities, including regulatory inspections and enquiries.
  • Provide AML reporting to senior management and relevant governance bodies, and coordinate audits, reviews and remediation activities.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 8–10 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in AML/CFT, financial crime or regulatory compliance in India.
  • Strong working knowledge of PMLA, PML Rules and FIU-IND requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FIU-IND reporting and FINnet, including STR/CTR filings.
  • Meet all applicable fit and proper requirements for appointment as Principal Officer / MLRO, including appropriate integrity, competence, experience and regulatory standing.
  • Qualify as an officer at management level for the purposes of appointment as Principal Officer under applicable PML Rules.
  • Based in India and able to engage directly with FIU-IND and other relevant authorities.

Preferred

  • Prior experience as a Principal Officer, MLRO, Compliance Officer or equivalent regulated role.
  • Experience within payments, fintech, banking or digital assets, with VDA/crypto experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics, sanctions, KYC/CDD and transaction monitoring.
  • Relevant AML certification such as CAMS.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.  Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

descriptions.job-0a42n2p:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We bridge strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a collaborative, action-oriented Project Manager to join the Total Rewards Strategy and Enablement team. In this role, you’ll lead business-critical People projects, with a primary focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Bringing an acquired business into Stripe requires coordinated work across Total Rewards, People Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development. You’ll project manage the People workstream from diligence and integration planning through close and post-close execution. You’ll turn deal-specific decisions into clear plans, ownership, milestones, and risk-management approaches.

You’ll coordinate functional owners across People workstreams, establish plans and dependencies, and step into the work when needed to unblock progress or close critical gaps. Your work will support transaction timelines, reduce business disruption, and create a consistent experience for acquired Stripes.

You’ll build People M&A’s capabilities through repeatable playbooks, infrastructure, and cross-training. This individual contributor role is well suited to someone who can bring structure to ambiguity and move between strategy and execution.

Responsibilities

  • Project manage People M&A workstreams from diligence and planning through close and post-close execution. Workstreams may include organizational alignment, employee data, onboarding, recruiting, and people program integration.
  • Serve as a central coordination point across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Operations, People Systems, Recruiting, People Support, Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Technology.
  • Align plans, dependencies, decisions, and accountability with transaction timelines.
  • Develop and run integration and change-management plans that give functional leads, acquired Stripes, and other affected audiences the information and support they need at each stage of a transaction.
  • Identify cross-functional dependencies, risks, and blockers early. Coordinate resolution and escalate issues when needed to protect integration timelines and the Stripe experience.
  • Establish feedback and support mechanisms for acquired Stripes, including surveys, office hours, and centralized support channels. Use feedback to improve integration plans and change-management approaches.
  • Build and improve People M&A’s infrastructure, including project plans, templates, checklists, playbooks, reporting, and retrospective documentation.
  • Build capability across People workstreams through documentation, cross-training, and shared practices that support more consistent future integrations.
  • Support other business-critical and transformational projects across Total Rewards and the People team as needed.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have 7+ years of project or program management experience at a global company, including 2+ years project managing workstreams within the M&A lifecycle, including diligence, integration planning, close readiness, and post-close integration.
  • You have experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and building repeatable program infrastructure, such as integration playbooks, project-plan templates, readiness checklists, risk logs, or retrospective processes.
  • You have a track record of turning ambiguous problems into structured, repeatable programs. You’re comfortable building new programs in a scaling environment while improving and standardizing how work gets done.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can write a one-page executive update, a decision memo tailored to stakeholders, and a step-by-step operator playbook with equal fluency. You guide project teams through complex work in a direct, approachable, and inclusive way.
  • You can manage senior cross-functional stakeholders across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Systems, Recruiting, Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance. You know when to build alignment, raise a risk, and escalate.
  • You’re comfortable working with data and systems such as Workday and Greenhouse. You use data to clarify decisions, communicate recommendations, and define requirements with People Systems partners.
  • You focus on the experience of acquired Stripes and the teams operating the program, not only on program artifacts.
  • You can manage competing priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment. You work effectively independently and across teams, bring structure to complexity, and follow through on the details that make a program successful.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with change management frameworks, such as the Prosci ADKAR Model, and applying them to employee or operational change.
  • Project or program management certification or training, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean, Six Sigma, or a comparable methodology
descriptions.job-1unfqj5:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe, LLC. is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to team strategy, roadmap, tooling, process, and culture. Scope, design, implement, and deploy robust solutions, making appropriate tradeoffs between reliability, throughput, latency, resiliency, engineering velocity and cost. 
  • Innovate, design and implement software solutions that contribute towards improvement in infrastructure resiliency, reliability, efficiency and management at scale. 
  • Uphold our high engineering standards and improve our codebase and processes.

Who you are

Minimum requirements

Must have a Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, plus 5 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate experience in Software development. 

Must also have 5 years of experience in each of the following:

  • Developing, maintaining and debugging distributed systems built with open source tools;
  • Building infrastructure as a product centered around users’ needs;
  • Scaling distributed systems;
  • Breaking down large complex systems;
  • Identifying shortcomings and optimization opportunities to make data driven cost performance tradeoffs to influence design decisions;

About the Opportunity
The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We’re a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company’s regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.
In this role, you will own OKX's Global Customer Complaints Program and report directly to the Compliance Chief of Staff. You will work closely with Local Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Risk teams to promote consistent complaint handling across jurisdictions, maintain alignment with regulatory requirements, and provide effective second-line oversight and challenge.
A key part of the role will be turning customer complaints into actionable compliance and conduct-risk intelligence. You will oversee complaints governance and quality assurance, identify trends and potential systemic issues, support root-cause analysis and remediation, and provide senior leadership with clear reporting on customer outcomes and emerging risks.
You will also support the development, coordination, and tracking of responses to regulators, working directly with Legal and Local Compliance teams on regulatory inquiries, escalated complaints, and related supervisory matters. This requires strong regulatory judgment, excellent written communication, and the ability to coordinate complex matters across multiple teams and jurisdictions.
 
What You'll Be Doing
  • Develop, coordinate, and track responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and escalated complaints, partnering with Legal and Local Compliance teams to gather and validate facts, prepare clear and defensible responses, manage review and approval processes, meet regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments, remediation, and follow-up through closure.
  • Maintain global regulatory alignment by partnering with local Heads of Compliance to identify changes in jurisdictional requirements and ensure global policies, standards, procedures, and local requirements remain current and appropriately implemented.
  • Oversee the end-to-end complaints control framework, including complaint identification and classification, regulatory and internal service-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, investigation and resolution expectations, and closed-loop validation.
  • Own the second-line oversight and quality assurance, including risk-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer-outcome issues, tracking of remediation, and escalation of issues.
  • Turn complaint data into actionable compliance and conduct-risk intelligence by monitoring trends, recurring issues, root causes, regulatory complaints, overdue cases, customer outcomes, and potential systemic issues requiring broader investigation or remediation.
  • Own complaints governance and executive reporting, including reporting to compliance committees and serving as the standing owner of the complaints agenda for compliance leadership meetings.
  • Maintain the complaint management database, service level agreement adherence, and escalation thresholds across all regions.
  • Serve as the central Compliance point of contact for material complaint matters, including complaints or inquiries escalated to regulators, ensuring consistent governance, appropriate escalation, and defensible documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the framework, using QA results, regulatory developments, complaint trends, and lessons learned to strengthen controls and improve customer outcomes globally.
 
What We Look For In You
  • Strong experience developing and managing responses to regulators is required, including regulatory inquiries, information requests, examinations, escalated customer complaints, and other supervisory matters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional inputs, develop clear and defensible written responses, manage regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.
  • Significant experience in regulatory compliance, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints oversight, or a related discipline, ideally within a highly regulated and globally distributed organization.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or overseeing a multi-jurisdictional compliance framework, including translating regulatory requirements into scalable global standards, controls, monitoring, and governance while appropriately incorporating local requirements.
  • Strong regulatory and customer-outcome judgment, with the ability to distinguish individual service issues from matters presenting potential regulatory, conduct, consumer-harm, reputational, or systemic risk.
  • Demonstrated experience with root-cause analysis and systemic remediation, including assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and driving appropriate corrective action.
  • Strong second-line oversight and challenge capabilities, with experience designing or operating risk-based monitoring, QA, issue escalation, remediation tracking, and governance processes.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, trend analysis, SLA monitoring, management information, and executive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with regulators, Legal, Compliance, senior executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence geographically dispersed teams and senior stakeholders.
 
Nice-To-Haves
  • Experience designing or overseeing a global customer complaints program across multiple regulatory regimes, particularly the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, APAC, LATAM, and/or Middle East.
  • Familiarity with complaints-handling and customer protection expectations across major global regulatory regimes, including those established by the FCA, CFPB, MAS, European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA and EIOPA), and other relevant national competent authorities and dispute-resolution bodies.
  • Relevant professional certification or advanced qualification such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, CCEP/CCEP-I, ICA compliance qualifications, CIA, CRCMP, JD or equivalent legal qualification, or a comparable compliance, risk, or audit credential.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
 
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Global Partnership Development: Build and scale strategic partnerships with brokerage firms, financial platforms, financial influencers/KOLs, investor communities, and other relevant ecosystem partners across key global markets, driving user acquisition, trading activity, AUM, and revenue growth.
  • End-to-End Partnership Management: Own the full partnership lifecycle, including market mapping, outreach, commercial negotiation, partnership design, launch, and ongoing performance management.
  • Commercial Strategy & Optimization: Develop and optimize revenue-sharing structures, incentive models, and customized partnership solutions to improve ROI, partner productivity, and customer retention.
  • Market Expansion: Identify and evaluate new partnership channels, customer segments, and geographic opportunities to support international growth.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Monitor global financial-market trends, evolving customer behavior, and competitor partnership strategies to identify emerging opportunities and develop differentiated go-to-market initiatives.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product, marketing, operations, compliance, and regional teams to ensure partnership initiatives are scalable, commercially effective, and appropriate for different markets.
  • 全球渠道及合作伙伴拓展：面向全球重点市场，拓展并深化与券商、金融平台、财经KOL/内容创作者、投资者社区及其他生态合作伙伴的战略合作，推动新客、交易量、AUM及收入增长。
  • 全链路合作管理：独立负责从市场及合作伙伴挖掘、商务拓展、合作谈判、方案设计，到上线执行及后续数据复盘的完整合作流程。
  • 商业模式优化：结合不同市场及合作伙伴特点，设计并持续优化分润机制、激励方案及定制化合作模式，提升合作ROI、渠道产出及客户留存。
  • 全球市场拓展：持续识别新的合作渠道、客户群体及区域市场机会，支持业务的国际化增长。
  • 市场洞察与竞品分析：紧密关注全球金融市场趋势、用户需求变化及行业竞品的渠道策略，识别新的增长机会并制定差异化的市场拓展方案。
  • 跨团队协作：与产品、市场、运营、合规及区域团队紧密合作，推动合作项目在不同市场高效落地并实现规模化增长。

 

What We Look For In You

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with 2–5 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, channel development, or related commercial roles within brokerage, fintech, wealth management, trading, or financial services.
  • Experience working with international or multi-market financial platforms is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of brokerage, investment, or trading ecosystems, including partnership structures, distribution channels, customer acquisition models, and commercial incentive mechanisms.
  • Existing relationships with brokerage firms, financial platforms, financial content creators, investor communities, or other relevant financial ecosystem partners are a plus.
  • Familiarity with, or strong interest in, digital assets and crypto, with the ability to understand the evolving relationship between traditional finance and emerging digital-asset products.
  • Strong commercial judgment, negotiation, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, with a proven ability to translate partnerships into measurable business outcomes.
  • Results-oriented, highly self-motivated, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, international, and evolving business environment.
  • Strong cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different regions and functions.
  • 本科及以上学历，具备2–5年券商、金融科技、财富管理、交易平台或其他金融服务领域的商务拓展、战略合作、渠道拓展或相关商业经验。
  • 有国际化金融平台或跨区域市场工作经验者优先。
  • 熟悉券商、投资或交易生态，包括渠道体系、客户获取模式、合作机制及商业激励模式。
  • 在券商、金融平台、财经KOL/内容创作者、投资者社区或其他相关金融生态中拥有合作资源者优先。
  • 对数字资产及加密行业具备一定理解或强烈兴趣，能够理解传统金融与新兴数字资产产品之间不断演进的用户及商业需求。
  • 具备较强的商业判断、商务谈判、利益相关方管理及数据分析能力，能够将合作机会转化为可量化的业务成果。
  • 结果导向、自驱力强，能够适应快速变化、国际化的业务环境。
  • 具备良好的跨文化沟通及跨区域协作能力。

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

descriptions.job-0jk6235:
About the company
 
Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.
 
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

As a Backend Engineer on Ondo's market making team, you'll build and scale the infrastructure behind our trading stack - real-time systems that quote and hedge tokenized markets 24/7 across on-chain and traditional venues. This is a small, senior team, working in Rust and Go, with high ownership over live production risk.

You'll work across systems that manage pricing, execution, and PnL accounting, integrating market data from both traditional venues and on-chain sources. You'll collaborate closely with the trading and infrastructure teams to define robust interfaces and deliver systems that hold up under real-time, high-throughput conditions.

This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of Web2 and Web3, in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement low-latency backend systems and APIs for quoting, hedging, and executing across on-chain and traditional trading venues.
  • Collaborate with the trading team to define interfaces and workflows between pricing, execution, and market data services.
  • Own integrations with market data providers, exchanges, and on-chain venues, including feed handling and order execution.
  • Build reconciliation and data-integrity tooling so positions, fills, and PnL stay consistent across live trading state.
  • Establish and enforce backend engineering standards, best practices, and security protocols across the stack.
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions, contributing to a culture of engineering excellence.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, with strong programming ability in Go or Rust, and willingness to work in both.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, system design, and building services that run under real-time or latency-sensitive conditions.
  • Experience integrating with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), third-party services, and high-throughput, production-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated interest in Web3, DeFi, or trading systems—whether through professional experience or side projects.
  • Familiarity with market microstructure or order execution is a plus, but not required.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment with high ambiguity and high ownership over live production risk.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with market data providers and protocols (Databento, SIP/prop equity feeds, venue WebSocket APIs).
  • Prior work on trading systems, execution infrastructure, or market data infrastructure at a trading firm, exchange, or broker.
  • Exposure to crypto venues and on-chain trading.
 
What we offer
 
• Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation
• Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)
• Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices
• A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom
• Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures
descriptions.job-0jlfck1:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 

About the team:

Web Presence & Platform (WPP) is organized into two pillars: Platform and Presence. The Platform pillar builds internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure to support the web. The Presence pillar owns Stripe’s public-facing storytelling across stripe.com, including our homepage, product landing pages, industry and solutions pages, and other high-impact go-to-market surfaces. Together, we shape how millions of people understand what Stripe is and what it can do for them.

Designers on the Presence team work at the intersection of craft and impact—balancing clarity, polish, and systems thinking with strategic storytelling and experimentation. We collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, content, and product to deliver work that is not only beautiful, but measurably moves the business.

 

What you’ll do

As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll contribute to the strategy and execution of Stripe’s most visible web surfaces. You’ll design new product pages, evolve storytelling for specific industries or audiences, and refine reusable patterns that make it easier to scale exceptional work across stripe.com. This is a high-impact role for a thoughtful, collaborative designer who deeply values visual craft, user clarity, and iteration.

We’re looking for someone who’s excited to operate at the intersection of storytelling, systems, and scale—and who takes pride in the pixels. Your work will directly shape how millions of users understand Stripe, and help convert interest into action across a range of audiences—from founders to enterprise CTOs.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design new and improved experiences across stripe.com, including product, industry, and solution landing pages
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMMs, and content designers to define problems, explore solutions, and bring them to life
  • Partner with other designers to maintain and evolve systems that uphold Stripe’s design standards at scale
  • Balance storytelling with usability to create pages that are engaging, credible, and easy to navigate
  • Use user research, user testing, and data to guide and validate your decisions
  • Participate in critique and feedback sessions, contributing to the overall quality bar of the team
  • Demonstrate a meticulous attention to craft—ensuring designs are not only functional, but visually excellent

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification.

Minimum requirements

  • 2–4 years of relevant design experience, ideally in web or product marketing contexts
  • A strong portfolio of web design work that demonstrates exceptional visual design skills, systems thinking, and attention to detail
  • Ability to independently scope and lead small to medium-sized projects
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
  • Fluency in layout, typography, color, hierarchy, and interaction fundamentals
  • Comfortable using Figma and working in component-based systems
  • Experience working on CMS-driven websites and modular systems

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with front-end development workflows or an ability to speak fluently with engineers
  • Understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices
  • Experience designing for international audiences or multilingual websites
  • Previous experience in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

How we work

We care deeply about craft—but also about moving with urgency and focus. We seek feedback early and often, because we believe design gets stronger through collaboration and iteration. We keep our users front and center—whether that’s a small business owner evaluating Stripe for the first time, or a CTO trying to understand a complex product at a glance. And we take pride in delivering work that is not only beautiful and precise, but that delivers clear, measurable impact.

We value curiosity, humility, and resilience. You’ll do well here if you love to learn, enjoy working across disciplines, and bring energy and optimism into your work.

This is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow. Designers on the Presence team have gone on to lead major product launches, shape system-wide improvements, and take on leadership roles. You'll be supported by experienced peers and have space to develop your craft, influence, and ownership over time.
descriptions.job-0u00rdd:
Crypto Finance Group, part of Deutsche Börse Group, provides professional digital asset solutions to institutional clients. The Group comprises Crypto Finance AG, regulated by FINMA in Switzerland, offering trading, custody, and wallet services, as well as Crypto Finance (Deutschland) GmbH, regulated by BaFin in Germany, offering trading and custody services. In January 2025, Crypto Finance secured a MiCAR license for the European market as one of the first providers in the EU. Crypto Finance AG is a SIX-approved crypto custodian for ETP issuers.

For more information, please visit our website at About us - Crypto Finance

About the role:

As a Cross-Product Platform Owner, you will be responsible for keeping the platform and its run-the-business workflows running smoothly by continuously fine-tuning it in form of improvements and bugfix tickets. You will also support both current and future clients to integrate with our platform, testing their workflows and getting them running. Additionally, you will assist the change-the-business product managers with the platform-specific aspects of their projects. This means that you will often act as the bridge between front office, client users, and technology, ensuring that our platform capabilities and APIs enable efficient, scalable, and customer-centric solutions.

This role requires a strong understanding of APIs and system integrations, combined with a good grasp of platforms that are shared across products, accounting, and financial workflows to support customers operating in financial environments.

The starting date is as soon as possible at our office on the 24th floor of the Prime Tower in Zurich.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the cross-product platform strategy and integration roadmap
  • Define and optimize workflows that connect multiple products and services
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers to align platform capabilities with business and customer needs
  • Support customers and partners in integrating our solutions through APIs and other integration technologies
  • Gather customer feedback and translate business requirements into platform improvements.
  • Work with Engineering teams to prioritize and deliver platform enhancements
  • Ensure a consistent, scalable, and user-centric product experience across all solutions, serving the needs of both our customers and internal teams such as Operations
  • Provide guidance and best practices for API usage, integrations, and workflow design
  • Own and enhance the platform capabilities related to tasks and activities that are performed by Operations
  • Identify opportunities to streamline accounting-related processes and data flows
  • Act as platform expert and level 2 support for possible production incidents
  • Act as business release manager for deployments of new platform software versions (including testing and release notes)
  • Ideally, at least 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Platform Owner, Business Analyst, Solution Consultant, or similar role
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and system interoperability
  • Experience supporting customers or partners with technical integrations
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of accounting principles, financial processes, or ERP systems
  • Experience working in Agile product development environments
  • Understanding of workflow automation and business process design
  • Experience with Front-to-back workflows including basic accounting flows (T-accounts, debit vs. credit etc.)
  • Experience with operational workflow management
  • Knowledge of swift-based payments and reports

What success looks like

  • Customers can easily integrate our products into their existing ecosystems
  • Product teams have clear and efficient cross-product workflows
  • Platform capabilities are aligned with strategic business goals
  • API adoption and customer satisfaction continue to grow
  • Operators have efficient workflows to perform payments and settlements
  • Accounting and financial workflows are streamlined and well-supported across products
  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note:

  • We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
  • Due to the Swiss labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland (are in possession of a Swiss work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

descriptions.job-01o4zo1:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the role

Ramp is building a new AI business, and you’ll be one of its first technical sellers. Your job is to turn technically complex AI products into closed revenue.

You’ll sell a growing portfolio spanning AI-powered applications and agents for finance teams, as well as infrastructure that helps companies deploy and manage AI with greater control, security, and cost efficiency. This is a product-focused, quota-carrying technical sales role. You’ll help customers evaluate and purchase Ramp’s AI products, translating complex capabilities into clear business value and guiding opportunities from discovery through close.

This is a high-velocity commercial role, not a traditional pre-sales position where success ends with a great demo. You’ll be accountable for turning technical evaluations into commercial wins from start to finish. You’ll lead discovery, shape deal strategy, build executive-level business cases, deliver tailored demonstrations, navigate technical and commercial objections, and create urgency around a clear path to purchase.

You’ll move comfortably between technical and executive conversations. In one meeting, you may discuss model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT teams. In the next, you may help Finance and executive leaders understand the ROI, total cost of ownership, and operational impact of adopting Ramp’s AI products.

You’ll join at a formative moment for Ramp’s AI business. As one of the first dedicated sellers for these products, you’ll help identify the strongest use cases, refine how we position and sell the portfolio, influence the customer experience, and build the playbook the broader team will eventually scale. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle from discovery and evaluation through close, implementation, and adoption, helping customers translate their purchase into a successful deployment. This role combines Ramp’s resources and customer reach with the ownership, speed, and ambiguity of an early-stage team.

What you’ll do

  • Carry a revenue quota and own the progression of AI product opportunities from initial discovery through purchase, ensuring business value is clear, technical requirements are validated, and obstacles to a decision are resolved.

  • Lead discovery with business and technical buyers to understand their goals, workflows, challenges, decision criteria, existing systems, and AI strategy.

  • Translate Ramp’s AI applications and infrastructure into compelling solution narratives tied to measurable business outcomes.

  • Build ROI and total cost of ownership analyses that quantify the value of Ramp’s AI products and create executive-level justification for investment.

  • Help customers identify high-value use cases, set realistic expectations, and establish a credible path from evaluation to production.

  • Deliver tailored demonstrations, technical workshops, and proofs of concept with clear success criteria that establish value and build confidence in a purchase decision.

  • Build relationships with champions and decision-makers across Engineering, IT, Security, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and executive leadership.

  • Navigate questions related to APIs, integrations, model capabilities and limitations, data flows, architecture, privacy, security, governance, implementation, and tradeoffs among quality, cost, latency, and control.

  • Apply strong commercial judgment to qualify opportunities, create urgency, address objections, identify risk, and keep customers moving toward a decision.

  • Lead customers through implementation after purchase, including deployment planning, stakeholder alignment, workflow design, technical coordination, enablement, and adoption.

  • Partner with Account Executives and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Security, Marketing, and post-sales teams to remove deployment blockers and deliver a strong customer experience from evaluation through production.

  • Bring structured customer and market feedback to internal teams to improve the products, positioning, sales execution, and customer experience.

  • Turn early customer conversations into repeatable messaging, demonstrations, qualification criteria, value stories, and sales plays as we build this go-to-market motion from the ground up.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical sales, Solutions Architecture, enterprise software sales, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle—not only experience delivering demonstrations or supporting post-sale implementation.

  • A track record of independently influencing and winning complex B2B sales opportunities with clear revenue accountability.

  • Strong discovery and value-selling skills, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to build executive-level business cases, including ROI and total cost of ownership analyses; this capability will be central to success in the role.

  • Commercial instincts and comfort taking meaningful ownership of deal strategy, momentum, and results.

  • Technical fluency across modern AI systems, including applications and agents, model capabilities and limitations, APIs, integrations, data flows, security, governance, and tradeoffs among quality, cost, latency, and control.

  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex concepts clear and relevant to different audiences.

  • The ability to explain probabilistic, rapidly evolving AI technology with credibility and precision without overpromising what the product can do.

  • Experience building champions and navigating multi-threaded buying groups with competing priorities.

  • High ownership, curiosity, sound judgment, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where you’ll build structure as you go rather than inherit it.

  • Energy for zero-to-one work and the opportunity to build a sales motion rather than simply inherit one.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling AI infrastructure, AI applications or agents, developer tools, data platforms, security products, finance technology, or workflow automation software.

  • Experience helping launch a new product or develop an early go-to-market motion.

  • Familiarity with AI gateways, model routing, usage controls, data governance, or enterprise AI deployment.

  • Experience selling to developers, IT, Security, Finance, Operations, Procurement, or executive stakeholders.

  • Experience creating reusable sales assets, demonstrations, value frameworks, or enablement programs.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

descriptions.job-1sfg00h:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Opportunity

The North American Sales team at Block is responsible for driving revenue to Block’s core businesses (Afterpay & Cash App) through commerce, giving our Merchant partners access to the largest and most engaged network of next generation consumers. 

We are looking for a high-energy, dynamic, and strategic Account Executive to forge and expand Block’s relationships with mid-size brands, unlocking new revenue opportunities across our expanding portfolio of payments products. You will be on the front lines of a fast-growing payments business, responsible for leading commercial negotiations, with a goal of partnering with business owners and executives of high-growth companies. 

A successful candidate should thrive in a challenging, fast-paced environment, have a passion for developing client relationships, and exhibit a strong sense of ownership to win new business for Block. You will have a demonstrated ability to operate with velocity, navigate ambiguity, think strategically and operationally about business, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to launch product and commercial initiatives.

We are much more than our job descriptions - we are our energy, our ideas, our everyday drive. Here’s where you will begin…

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.
You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.
  • Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.
  • Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.
  • Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.
  • Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.

Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.
  • Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..

  • Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.
  • An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.
  • Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.
  • Experience in data-driven product decision-making and risk change management, with the ability to define effective metrics and drive continuous improvement through simulation, backtesting, stress testing, production monitoring, and incident reviews.
  • Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.
  • Rigorous logical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and fluency in both Chinese and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams across global and Chinese-language working environments.

Nice-To-Haves

  • A deep understanding of the trading and risk mechanisms for spot, margin, perpetuals, expiry futures, or options, with familiarity with core concepts including the order lifecycle, margin, leverage, liquidation, position tiers, index price, mark price, and price limits.
  • Experience working at a digital asset exchange, securities or futures exchange, brokerage, clearing platform, market-making firm, quantitative trading firm, or another high-throughput trading environment.
